# Task (OpenAI)

In Codex Cloud and Codex on mobile, OpenAI calls a [session][industry.session] a task ([Codex on mobile][o8], [changelog][o9]), where Claude Code says [session][anthropic.session]. OpenAI also says task for scheduled work, a sense no card here takes, so the industry's cards never use task as a term.
